sql.messageTemplate.getAllTemplates: select id, title, message, to_jsonb(team_ids) as teamIds, archived from flow.message_template mt where mt.archived is not true
sql.messageTemplate.getTemplates: select id, title, message, to_jsonb(team_ids) as teamIds, archived from flow.message_template mt where mt.archived is not true and :teamId::integer = any(mt.team_ids)
sql.messageTemplate.getTemplate: select id, title, message, to_jsonb(team_ids) as teamIds, archived from flow.message_template mt where mt.archived is not true and id = :id
sql.messageTemplate.insertTemplate: insert into flow.message_template (title, message, team_ids, created_by_id, date_created, modified_by_id, date_modified) values (:title, :message, array[ :teamIds ]::integer[], :createdById, now(), :createdById, now())
sql.messageTemplate.updateTemplate: update flow.message_template set title = :title, message = :message, team_ids = array[ :teamIds ]::integer[], modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.messageTemplate.deleteTemplate: update flow.message_template set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
